correctness.rationale: Every binary order-five de Bruijn cycle is uniquely encoded by a 16-bit nonsingular successor-rule table and anchored at its unique 00000 state; all 65536 functions are tested. An independent Euler-circuit DFS exactly matches every count. Exact residual Euler graph analysis excludes centered length-14 and length-17 palindromes and therefore all spans above 15; the ubiquitous 1000001 factor establishes the lower bound 7. Explicit lexicographically normalized complement/reversal orbits exhaust and reconcile with all 2048 cycles. Four standalone executables were run; finite exhaustiveness derives from proved enumeration bijections, not empirical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The longest palindromic contiguous window is a natural quantitative reversal obstruction for cyclic universal words, motivated by 2024 work on orientability. This exact classification resolves its sharp order-five distribution and symmetry orbit types in the first tractable nontrivial odd setting; counts and bounds are not forced by the classical 2048 total or by known CR symmetry counts. It is a complete exact natural invariant, not an arbitrary parameter cut.
